title: Patient identity and required content
environment: three demo databases: carejiox, carejiox_template, hhh; synthetic isolated tests on codex_vn2026
state: Implemented controls with scoped verification; independent review and remaining actions pending
implemented_controls: Identity-readiness view flags missing/nonstandard CCCD and conflicting identity values, permits documented review exceptions and avoids blocking ordinary care. Manual VNeID assertion is distinguished from government authentication.
remaining_actions: Verify identity ownership and approved exceptions. Custodian-approved clinical form/data-field inventory and destination-specific mandatory-content checks remain to be finalised; format checks do not establish authenticity.
limitations: Automated tests and demo evidence establish stated software behavior only. They do not establish every legal obligation, production suitability, authority acceptance or MPS certification.
